tracks.prompt: Dark cinematic space documentary underscore. Slow evolving synth pads, deep sub bass drone, a soft ticking pulse that builds quiet tension, distant airy textures. Minimal, no melody that distracts, no drums, no vocals. Designed to sit quietly under a narrator's voice. 70 bpm, D minor. Steady and even from start to finish so it can loop seamlessly, no big intro, no ending.
